svg.title: A Named Response: Sumuroy in Samar
svg.desc: A named case: The NHCP marker connects Sumuroy and Palapag with protest against forced labor and abuses in 1649.. Distance: CulturEd describes a demand for workers to go to Cavite for shipbuilding.. Scope: A named uprising does not establish every workers response or private motive.
